thread:
elaine: Starting staged rollout v2024.11 -> canary 10% (us-east / eu-west). Quick FYI: support flagged user reports of truncated outputs + a small uptick in 502s from eu-west. Can we do a stop/go?

deploy-bot: deploy 1900009999 initiated by elaine — canary -> 10% traffic. Targets healthy: 6/60. Logs: `svc:ingress|tokenizer` tailing. :rocket:

piotr: Which tokenizer binary shipped? We intended token-fix-7 with fallback default on, but artifact shows fallback=false. That would explain truncation under certain eviction races.

ops-runner: Recommend immediate hold at 10%. Two low-risk mitigations: 1) remote toggle `tokenizer.fallback=true` for selector rollout=canary, observe 10m; 2) if errors persist, pin traffic back to v2024.10 (route pin) and mark as rollback. Which do folks prefer?

elaine: Toggle first. If that stabilizes we'll continue bake then ramp. Who runs the toggle?

infra: running: `rwctl prod config set tokenizer.fallback=true --selector rollout=canary`

infra: 6 targets matched. applying config...

infra: config rollout complete on 6/6 targets. change-id=cfg-1900009999-a status=success.

ops-runner: Watching metrics. 7m in: eu-west 502-rate down from 0.7% -> 0.12%. truncation reports reduced. p95 latency improved ~40ms. Recommend bake for 15m then decision.

piotr: I replayed 150 long-system prompts against canary and saw 2 truncations. Stack snippet: ```
ERROR token::clip at pos 10240
stack: tokenizer::emit -> kvcache::evict raced
```

elaine: Good catch. Release notes need a line about fallback behavior and the quick remediation steps. notes-bot, can you patch the draft?

notes-bot: patching `release/v2024.11` with: "Known issue: tokenizer may truncate on long prompts under rare cache eviction race; fallback enabled for safety during canary. See troubleshooting steps." PR created: release/v2024.11-notes-1900

release-manager: Vote check — :thumbsup: to proceed to 25% after 15m bake if metrics hold, :thumbsdown: to keep hold / rollback. Please respond.

elaine: :thumbsup: (after bake)

piotr: :thumbsup: (fallback looks good)

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (Ill keep alarms on)

release-manager: Consensus -> ramp after bake. Annotating rollout ticket with change-id cfg-1900009999-a and notes PR. Scheduling ramp to 25% at ~1900010900 unless a hold is raised.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1900009999: "fallback enabled; bake hold started; cfg-1900009999-a"

elaine: Thanks team. If the truncation or 5xx rate reappears during the bake we call emergency:rollback and pin to v2024.10.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% at 1900010900 (ETA ~15m).
